2.6-CV_Color_by_Cycle.comment:
CSV Color Mapping Tool: Interpolates colors based on reference column values.

【Mapping Modes】

- numeric: Linearly maps value range [min, max] to color map.
- discrete: Maps unique sorted values equidistantly. If count matches color count, maps 1-to-1.
- auto: Automatic. Uses numeric if column is all numbers, otherwise discrete.

【Color Reference】 red, blue, green, yellow, black, white, orange, purple, pink, grey, navy, gold...

Decimals can be used for grayscale.
